page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores built on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The CPU architecture supports hyper-threading along with instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. Equipped with 128 GB of RAM, it maintains a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB RAM per vCPU. The instance operates under a KVM hypervisor with dedicated CPU allocation, includes no local ephemeral storage, and provides a 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

In benchmark testing, the instance displays distinct multi-core efficiency alongside lower single-thread execution rates. Single-core tests such as Geekbench single-core and single-threaded Gzip compression place in lower performance tiers, reflecting the moderate 2.5 GHz base clock speed. Multi-core execution scales effectively, achieving average ratings across Geekbench multi-core, PassMark CPU, and stress-ng multi-core evaluations. Memory bandwidth reaches 119.7 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 55.79 GB/sec for writes. The hardware profile offers balanced resource density for general enterprise workloads without the cost overhead of dedicated local NVMe storage or discrete GPU accelerators.

Workload evaluations show steady throughput for parallelized microservices and backend applications. Static web serving reaches 14.04 GB/sec, while Redis SET operations achieve 23.48 million requests per second. Software compilation with Clang and medium-scale language model inference processing yield average throughput metrics. The instance is suited for general-purpose applications, distributed web microservices, intermediate database caching, and multi-threaded ETL jobs where multi-core scaling balances lower single-threaded performance.
